parts.text: State the law of conservation of momentum.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
Two particles A and B collide elastically, as illustrated in Fig. 5.1.

{{figure:figure_5_1.png}}

The initial velocity of A is $500\text{ m s}^{-1}$ in the $x$-direction and B is at rest.

The velocity of A after the collision is $v_{A}$ at $60^{\circ}$ to the $x$-direction. The velocity of B after the collision is $v_{B}$ at $30^{\circ}$ to the $x$-direction.

The mass $m$ of each particle is $1.67 \times 10^{-27}\text{ kg}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by the particles colliding *elastically*.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Calculate the total initial momentum of A and B.

momentum = .................... N s

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
State an expression in terms of $m$, $v_{A}$ and $v_{B}$ for the total momentum of A and B after the collision

1. in the $x$-direction,

2. in the $y$-direction.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text:
Calculate the magnitudes of the velocities $v_{A}$ and $v_{B}$ after the collision.

$v_A$ = ................... . m s⁻¹

$v_B$ = ................... . m s⁻¹
